'''Particle accelerators''' were used in [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] and in the creation of [[Tributary beam|particle accelerator tubes]]. The [[Roche system]] contained a particle accelerator the size of the inner [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
